purpose: Public-safe inventory and conservative crosswalk of ProofAtlas collaboration workspaces. It does not append records, reconstruct statements, verify current openness, or rescore OPDP.

routing_policy.append_worthiness: Always false in this inventory pending per-workspace source recovery and curator approval.
routing_policy.appendable_no_strong_match: Open source card with a minimally well-formed question and no strong frozen-OPDP match; a routing queue label only, not novelty proof or append authorization.
routing_policy.direct_top500_link: Use source-declared researchWorkspaces relation before lexical inference.
routing_policy.related_not_same: Only topical/title overlap was retained and it failed the statement gate.
routing_policy.same_problem_reviewed: Unique source-declared canonical link or unique frozen-OPDP title-plus-statement match.
routing_policy.unresolved: Ambiguous identity, non-open source status, or insufficient concise card evidence.
routing_policy.variant_or_subproblem: Source-declared special-case or stronger-formulation link; no independent append is authorized.

tool.name: OPDP ProofAtlas collaboration-directory conservative crosswalk builder
